slides.title: The interrupt — hardware makes the call
Bring to class
items: A timer is rate times count — prescaler, auto-reload, wrap, update event.
An interrupt is a function call hardware makes, and it can land anywhere.
Your ISR: exact name, quick in and out, volatile on anything shared.
In class you build all of it: Blinky with no delay_ms() anywhere.
